title: Snowsports School Tuition and the Rate Window the Collective's Own Dates Fall In
content:
The collective prices the same Snowsports School session differently by the rate window its own dates fall in, read from the state of the household's Resort Lodging reservation and the rate plan that reservation is priced on.

Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state priced on the holiday window, the holiday window supplement of 60.00 USD is added. Where the household holds a Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state priced on the peak window, the peak window supplement of 30.00 USD is added. Where the household holds no Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state, or its reservation is priced on the base window, the base window supplement is added, and it stands at 0 USD.

## Window and supplement

| Resort Lodging reservation standing in the confirmed state | Rate window the reservation is priced on | Supplement added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | holiday | 60.00 USD |
| yes | peak | 30.00 USD |
| yes | base | 0 USD |
| no | any window | 0 USD |

Both facts are read from the household's Resort Lodging records: the state the reservation stands in and the rate plan it is priced on. A reservation standing in a state other than confirmed carries no supplement whatever window it is priced on.

## Readings on hypothetical records

- A household whose confirmed Resort Lodging reservation is priced on the holiday window has 60.00 USD added to the tuition on its Snowsports School booking.
- The same household, its reservation priced on the peak window, has 30.00 USD added.
- A household whose Resort Lodging reservation is priced on the holiday window but does not stand in the confirmed state has nothing added on this count.
